//: Composite indexes for the feed queries in WorkoutDataSource.buildFeedQuery.
Firestore indexes single fields automatically, so 'order by createdAt' on its own needs
nothing. Combining an equality filter with an order does need a composite index, which is
what these two are: the category filter, ordered newest-first and most-liked-first.
Or create the first one from the link Firestore prints to Logcat the first time the query
runs (SPEC section 10). Until the index exists the feed shows its error state - correctly,
but the category filter will not return anything.
